Transform that expects a FetchResultWithTotalCount<FeatureFetchBase> and adds new fields
to each feature for the Model Scenario grid, given the ModelScenarioApplicationState#overriddenFeatures.
It adds the following fields:
edited: a string indicating that the feature is edited.
simulationModel: the type of the overridden feature.
newValue: a string representation of the new value for the feature, based on the type of the overridden feature.
